Method of Attack: Leaking Telnet passwords via an old vulnerability allowing retrieval of device setup config by sending malformed requests on port 30718
Exploitation of plaintext Telnet passwords in device configuration
Using Telnet access to send serial commands to connected ICS equipment
Discoverer: Ankit Anubhav, Principal Researcher at NewSky Security
Impacted Systems: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) equipment connected via Lantronix device servers
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerability on port 30718 to retrieve device config and Telnet passwords
Indicators of Compromise: 6,464 Lantronix device servers exposing Telnet passwords on Shodan
